{{Short description|Norwegian chemist (1935–2024)}}
[[File:Harald_A._Øye.jpg|thumb]]
'''Harald Arnljot Øye''' (1 February 1935 – 7 October 2024) was a Norwegian chemist.

==Biography==
Øye took the {{Interlanguage link|dr.techn.|no}} degree in 1963. He was a professor of [[inorganic chemistry]] at the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] from 1973 to his retirement. He has also led the International Course on Process Metallurgy of Aluminium since 1981.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Harald Arnljot Øye|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=|publisher=|location=|url=http://www.snl.no/Harald_Arnljot_%C3%98ye|language=Norwegian|accessdate=12 September 2012}}</ref><ref name=nbl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Harald Arnljot Øye|encyclopedia=[[Norsk biografisk leksikon]]|first=Trygve|last=Foosnæs|editor=[[Knut Helle|Helle, Knut]]|publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget|location=Oslo|url=http://www.snl.no/.nbl_biografi/Harald_A_%C3%98ye/utdypning|language=Norwegian|accessdate=12 September 2012}}</ref> He was a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27627|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|title=Gruppe 4: Kjemi|language=Norwegian|accessdate=12 September 2012|archive-date=19 February 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120219071836/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27627|url-status=dead}}</ref> and the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ntva.no/index.php?option=com_club&view=member&id=507%3Aoye-harald-arnljot&Itemid=60|title=Medlemmer: ØYE, Harald Arnljot|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=29 December 2013}}</ref> In November 2016, FLOGEN Star Outreach awarded him the Fray International Sustainability Award at SIPS 2016 (Sustainable Industrial Processing Summit), in Hainan Island, China.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.flogen.org/?p=38&bio=Oye|title=Harald Oye winner of the Fray Award - FLOGEN Stars Outreach}}</ref> Øye died on 7 October 2024, at the age of 89.<ref>{{cite web |title=Harald Arnljot Øye |url=https://svanholm-vigdal.vareminnesider.no/memorial_page/memorial_page_personal_info.php?order_id=4373738&set_site_id=242&cat=home&sign=3d754a86b0b7a9a205f96c3565af017d |website=Svanholm & Vigdal Gravferd |access-date=10 October 2024}}</ref>
